# TrackFasts — Intermittent Fasting Timer App for iPhone & Apple Watch

> TrackFasts is a free, privacy-first intermittent fasting timer and streak tracker app for iPhone (iOS 17+) and Apple Watch (watchOS 10+). Start popular protocols (16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD) with a single tap, monitor real-time biological fasting stages (fat burning, ketosis, autophagy), and get on-device AI insights with zero account creation and 100% offline privacy.

By Das Group LLC.

## Core Capabilities
- **One-Tap Fasting Timer:** Instant start for 16:8 (Beginner), 18:6 (Intermediate), 20:4 (Advanced / Warrior), and 23:1 (OMAD - One Meal A Day).
- **Biological Fasting Stage Tracking:** Real-time tracking of 6 physiological phases:
  1. Fed State (0–4 hours): Nutrient absorption & insulin elevated
  2. Early Fasting / Glycogen Depletion (4–8 hours): Blood sugar normalizes, insulin drops
  3. Fat Burning (8–12 hours): Body switches to stored fat for energy
  4. Ketosis (12–16 hours): Elevated ketone production & mental clarity
  5. Autophagy Beginning (16–24 hours): Cellular cleanup and damaged protein recycling
  6. Deep Autophagy & Immune Renewal (24+ hours): Maximum cellular repair and immune regeneration
- **Apple Watch Companion App:** Start, pause, stop, and check current fasting stage and elapsed time directly from watchOS.
- **Live Activities & Dynamic Island:** Real-time progress ring, remaining time, and biological phase displayed on Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
- **Home & Lock Screen Widgets:** Multiple interactive WidgetKit widgets showing fasting progress, streak counter, and current fasting phase.
- **On-Device AI Insights Engine:** Analyzes personal fasting history to identify optimal fast start times, highest success days, best-performing protocols, and completion probability.
- **Streak & Consistency Tracking:** Daily reminders, visual streak calendar, and milestone predictions to build long-term fasting habits.
- **Weight Tracking with Trend Charts:** Log body weight (lbs/kg) with moving average trend lines and milestone forecasting.
- **Siri Shortcuts & App Intents:** Native voice control ("Start a 16:8 fast in TrackFasts", "End my fast in TrackFasts", "Fasting status in TrackFasts", "My fasting stats in TrackFasts").
- **100% Offline & Private:** Zero account creation, zero cloud servers, zero ad tracking. All health data remains strictly in the local iOS sandbox.
